title: Field Kit Return and Inspection Sequence
summary: Temporary routing order for returned field kits, ordinary inspection, and equipment-log reconciliation.

sections.title: ORDER CONTROL
sections.body:
**Order no.:** FS-2602

**Issuing division:** Field Operations

**Effective:** 2026-08-26 / return intake

**Expiration:** Completion of the current return and inspection reconciliation

**Issuing authority:** Field Operations Coordinator (role)

**Distribution:** Field teams, sample intake, and equipment support

sections.title: PURPOSE
sections.body:
**Operational requirement:** Route returned field kits through one inspection and log-reconciliation sequence before equipment is returned to ordinary storage.

**Reason:** Several routine returns fall within the same service interval.

**Desired end state:** Returned equipment checked, consumables reconciled, and unresolved maintenance items recorded.

sections.title: DIRECTED ACTIONS
sections.body:
**Personnel affected:** Returning field staff, intake staff, and equipment support.

**Required action:** Preserve kit labels through intake; compare contents with the issue log; separate service items from ready equipment.

**Prohibited action:** Do not return unchecked items directly to general issue storage.

**Record to maintain:** Field-kit issue, return, and service log.

sections.title: AUTHORITY & TERMINATION
sections.body:
**Exceptions authorized by:** Field Operations Coordinator (role).

**Automatic termination:** All listed kits reconciled or transferred to an ordinary service record.

**Extension requires:** Updated return list and revised completion date.

**Order status:** Active.

sections.title: SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS / SHIFT NOTES
sections.body: This order covers equipment routing only. Sample custody, analytical intake, and project records continue under their controlling procedures.

sections.title: ISSUER / RECEIVING SUPERVISOR ACKNOWLEDGMENT
sections.body: Field Operations issued the return sequence. Intake and equipment-support supervision acknowledged by role.
